title: Forma Building Design named Best in Category by Architectural Record
summary: With Forma Building Design, we’re helping architects explore options and understand their impact while their ideas are still taking shape.
body_markdown:
I’m


proud to share that


**Forma Building Design has been named Best in Category** in Architectural Record’s list of the Best Software and Technology Products of 2026.


This recognition matters because we know that the decisions made during schematic design – about a building’s form, layout and façade – greatly shape what follows. With Forma Building Design, we’re helping architects explore options and understand their impact while these ideas are still taking shape.


### What Forma Building Design helps architects do


[Forma Building Design](https://www.autodesk.com/products/forma-building-design/overview) is a cloud-based design and analysis software for schematic design. Architects can develop and compare building forms, explore floor plans and façades, and track area metrics and unit mix. Built-in analysis helps teams evaluate sun hours, daylight potential for façades, windows and interiors, and total carbon.


Forma Building Design connects schematic design to workflows across Autodesk Forma and Revit. Teams can begin in Forma Site Design, using site context and analysis to understand a site and explore its potential. They can then bring a proposal into Forma Building Design to develop and compare building forms, façades and floor plans, with analysis of daylight, sun hours and total carbon as designs change. From there, they can continue into Revit (as a Forma Connected Client) for detailed modeling and documentation.


Building Forma Building Design meant listening closely to the architects who would use it. Principal Product Manager and architect Arne Bjelland worked closely with customers to bring their feedback into the product. As he puts it:


*“This recognition belongs to the architects who tested early versions and shared honest feedback with the team. Building it together made the product better at every step. Proud to be part of it.”– Arne Bjelland, Principal Product Manager, Forma Building Design*


[Learn more about how user feedback shapes the future of Forma Building Design](https://blogs.autodesk.com/forma/2026/04/07/inside-forma-building-design-user-testing/)


### Connecting early design to what comes next


Our vision is to make early design exploration more connected – to bring site context, building design and performance analysis together so teams can test ideas sooner, have more informed conversations and move into detailed design with greater continuity.


Forma Building Design is part of our broader vision for Autodesk Forma: the AEC industry cloud that connects project information and workflows from early design through construction and operations. Strong construction management capabilities are essential to that vision, too. Autodesk was recently named a Leader in the[IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Construction Management Software 2026 Vendor Assessment](https://adsknews.autodesk.com/en/news/autodesk-named-as-a-leader-in-construction-management-software-idc/) , which evaluated those capabilities and identified our design-to-operate platform as a strength.


- [Read the award announcement in Architectural Record](https://www.architecturalrecord.com/articles/18519-best-software-and-technology-products-of-2026)
- [Explore Forma Building Design](https://www.autodesk.com/products/forma-building-design/overview)


### Frequently Asked Questions


**What is Forma Building Design?**


Forma Building Design is


a


design and analysis software for the schematic design phase.


Architects and designers use it to explore more ideas before


it’s


time for BIM — so they can shape options, test performance, and then move forward with confidence.


**How do I move a design from Forma Site Design into Forma Building Design?**


Use the direct connection between the products to bring a Site Design proposal into Building Design. Site Design supports planning and analysis at the broader site scale; Building Design lets you develop selected plots and buildings in more detail while


maintaining


alignment with the


site


concept.


**Can I progress a Forma Building Design project into Revit for detailed design?**


Yes. You can bring a design into Revit as a geolocated native model and continue developing it for detailed design and documentation. Revit’s Forma Connected Client connection supports a more continuous workflow between Forma and desktop modeling.


**What are the latest updates to Forma Building Design?**


Architects


[can now use](https://blogs.autodesk.com/forma/2026/11/04/whats-new-in-forma-building-design-indoor-daylight-parking-furniture-and-autocad-workflows/) Indoor Daylight analysis (in public beta) within Forma Building Design to assess natural light during occupied hours over a typical year; arrange parking and track stall counts; and add furniture to understand the scale of rooms. New AutoCAD workflows let teams import DXF floor plans to trace in Forma Building Design, then export designs as DWG files, choosing which buildings, components,


labels


and units to include.
